title: Certificates with unsupported public key algorithms trigger assertion
body:
The following certificate, which I believe was generated with wolfSSL/CyaSSL, uses the NTRU lattice-based public-key cryptosystem. Since this is probably not supported by most builds of OpenSSL, it triggers an assertion error at [x509.py:263](https://github.com/pyca/cryptography/blob/master/src/cryptography/hazmat/backends/openssl/x509.py#L263) upon calling `cryptography.x509.Certificate.public_key()` because the OpenSSL function `X509_get_pubkey()` returns NULL.

Not sure if this an actual bug or not, but reporting nonetheless.
